zepo.title: Full-Stack Developer
zepo.description: I was part of a startup selected for the Google for Startups program, where I worked on platforms related to cybersecurity and security-awareness. I contributed to the migration and removal of legacy code, and developed services, interactive dashboards, and data visualizations to display key metrics to users. I optimized and adapted a company add-on distributed through the Microsoft Store, improving its functionality. I designed and implemented analytical dashboards using TypeScript and Angular, integrated with REST APIs. I developed and managed NoSQL databases with MongoDB as the main system, complemented by MySQL for specific solutions, and used Python for automated processes and custom scripts. I implemented automated tests to improve the resolution of critical bugs. I used Docker to manage local environments. I worked under agile methodologies.

dialogo.title: Full-Stack Developer
dialogo.description: I created full-stack web solutions for external clients: single-page apps in Angular with reusable SASS/CSS components, REST APIs and JWT services in Spring Boot & Angular with MongoDB persistence, Docker containerization, and the integration of new components to improve scalability and maintainability in an agile setting.

abonOnline.name: AbonOnline
abonOnline.description:
AbonOnline is a web platform built with Node.js and Angular that centralizes information on points of sale and top-up locations for public-transport tickets through an interactive map.

Key features
  • Real-time geolocated search
  • Favorites and comments management
  • Admin panel with roles and statistics.

AbonOnline solves today's information fragmentation and brings public transport closer to citizens.

mantenlo.name: Mantenlo
mantenlo.description:
Mantenlo is a web app for restaurants that plans and verifies maintenance and hygiene tasks in every work area (kitchen, bar, storeroom…).

Key functions
  • Daily task board by zone
  • Zone and task manager
  • PDF document generator
  • Employee-level user management (active/inactive)
  • Employee activity log

With Mantenlo, staff comply with cleanliness and food-safety rules while management gets clear, traceable reports.

Mantenlo also helps implement and document the HACCP (Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points) system required in audits.

zemios.name: Zemios
zemios.description:
Zemios is a web community for junior developers built with NestJS, MySQL and MongoDB (via @nestjs/mongoose).

What it offers
  • A space to learn, collaborate and build real projects
  • Boosts professional growth and connects junior talent

The platform promotes hands-on learning while you grow your technical career.

reusable.title: Reusable components
reusable.description: TitleComponent unifies header presentation across sections (Experience, Studies, Stack, Projects). TechnologiesComponent receives an array of technologies and a showBackground flag, handles loading failures, applies entrance animations and displays tooltips.

main.title: Main components
main.description: ProjectsComponent organizes projects in a responsive grid, opens details in a modal and applies animations. StackComponent offers a tab system and cards with flip effect. FooterComponent displays contact links and social networks, as well as a button to copy the email.

directives.title: Directives and services
